title: Overcoming the Challenges of a Rapidly Expanding Team
author: Admired Leadership
summary: Warns that rapid team expansion, while energizing, poses one of the biggest risks to team culture because new hires arrive without institutional knowledge or lived experience of team norms and values. The piece's prescribed solution is codifying culture explicitly -- writing down values, norms, communication practices, and expected behaviors rather than leaving them implicit -- citing Netflix's Culture Memo, Amazon's Leadership Principles, and similar documents as models. Argues this codification benefits organizations of any growth pace, not just fast-scaling ones, because it makes an otherwise invisible culture teachable to newcomers.
points: Culture, not productivity, typically takes the biggest hit during rapid team expansion because new hires lack institutional knowledge and lived experience of norms.
Codifying values, norms, and expected behaviors explicitly (rather than leaving them implied) is the mechanism that speeds enculturation at scale.
Well-known examples -- Netflix's Culture Memo, Amazon's Leadership Principles, Zappos' Core Values -- show this codification works across very different organizations.
quotes: Rapid team expansion can be highly energizing, but it is also one of the riskiest phases for team culture, communication, and execution.
New team members are devoid of institutional knowledge, lack an appreciation for team norms, and have yet to experience the organization’s values in action.
To accomplish this at scale, the best organizations intentionally codify their cultures. They make their values, norms, practices, and expected behavior explicit instead of implied.
Netflix represents a prime example of an organization that has done a masterful job of codifying its culture.
While making the culture explicit can speed up the enculturation process for rapidly expanding teams, it also serves organizations and teams that grow more gradually.
Most cultures are invisible to newcomers. Good leaders bring the culture alive by making it clear and obvious in an easily consumed format.
